items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I want you to fix me a costume like Tom Brown of Six Brown Brothers.

ctx.x: That's a heck of a price. Lord! I mean, ninety-nine dollars in those days, good God...

It was a lot of money, but Doctor Moon said, 'You can pay me back two dollars a week.' I said, 'Okay,' and that's when I started playing. And I said, 'But I want a costume. I want you to fix me a costume like Tom Brown of Six Brown Brothers.' Do you remember the Six Brown Brothers, the saxophone sextet?
